name: High-Throughput Time-Series Metrics Pipeline
description: A production-grade Python package for ingesting time-series telemetry events, calculating rolling statistical windows (p50, p95, p99, mean), evaluating threshold-based alert triggers, and formatting dashboard JSON payloads.
acceptance_criteria: Module `telemetry/storage.py` providing an InMemoryRingBuffer with append and range query
Module `telemetry/statistics.py` calculating percentile, mean, and standard deviation over windows
Module `telemetry/alerts.py` evaluating AlertRule conditions against recent metric windows
Module `telemetry/exporter.py` generating JSON payload summaries ready for dashboard consumers
